title: Pitched one-shots: play a clip at a chosen pitch
description: Shared by chord strings (one hit strummed as a triad) and Melodies (apricitus-83b881). Needs: a hit's pitch from the analysis notes (basic-pitch) in its window (shot clips fall back to the whole recording's pitch profile today, manifest.rs:256); an engine mode that plays a clip at target pitches with chord voicing and strum.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live and verified 2026-09-26 (Amplify job 46, prod-smoke passed): on apricity.anth.us a harp string set to 'Play the chord (triad)' is heard as F3 and strums F A C / Bb D F; a notes melody on Thunderer shot-7 is heard as A4 and plays (17 rendered, peak 0.49).
